meaning: NATIVE_ENFORCEMENT_VERIFIED: on the real program, the gate held a real action, a denial stayed held, an approval let it through once, and a control showed the action runs with hooks removed. It does not mean the gate is a hard boundary: see the failure column. Self-run. Nobody independent has checked this.

entries.name: Hermes
entries.evidence: Gate and MCP verified with a scripted model only. A small local model never reached a push. Hosted models BLOCKED: no login
entries.install: agentontrack install hermes, then add what it prints. MCP needs Hermes' optional mcp package
entries.ifGateFails: Blocks, with fail_closed: true (observed). Its default fails open
entries.limitations: Hooks live in your own config, and its default fails open unless you keep fail_closed: true. MCP needs the optional mcp package, and without it the server silently does not load (observed)

entries.name: GitHub Copilot CLI

entries.install: agentontrack install copilot, then agentontrack run copilot
entries.capabilities: Pre-action gate on shell, file writes and MCP, approvals, MCP tools
entries.ifGateFails: Crash or missing program: blocks. Timeout or malformed output: RUNS THE ACTION (all observed)
entries.limitations: Plain copilot -p in an untrusted folder skips repo hooks, so the gate is silently off (observed). agentontrack run adds --trust-folder
